summary: MPEG Audio Layer 3 IMDCT synthesis filterbank stage. Stage one runs an 8-iteration butterfly over 64 16-bit subband samples (a1, a2) with fixed integer rotation coefficients (6270/4433/15137/20995/9633/16069/3196/7373/2446/16819/25172/12299), writing eight rounded int results ((x + 1024) >> 11) to the a3 output buffer. Stage two runs a second 8-iteration butterfly over that buffer, then performs four rounds of windowed byte-coefficient lookup into a6 (index ((x + 0x20000) >> 18) & 0x3FF) per output, packing four bytes into each of two dwords written through the a5 + a4[offset] pointer.

local_names.a1: first frequency-domain input vector (16-bit subband samples)
local_names.a2: second frequency-domain input vector (16-bit subband samples)
local_names.a3: output buffer (int) for the butterfly stage, then re-read as the stage-two input
local_names.a4: dword offset table indexing into the a5 region
local_names.a5: base of the time-domain output region
local_names.v42: packed 4-byte result for the even output slot
local_names.v43: packed 4-byte result for the odd output slot

operations.description: Stage-one loop: do-while 8 iterations (v50 countdown from 8); each iteration advances the input pointers a1/a2 and the output pointer v48 by one 16-bit element.

Butterfly group on element indices 0/16/32/48 (a1 and a2): products a2[16]*a1[16], a2[48]*a1[48] combined with coefficients 6270/4433/15137, plus (a1[0]*a2[0] +/- a1[32]*a2[32]) << 13, forming v52/v57/v61/v63/v65/v67.
Butterfly group on element indices 8/24/40/56 (a1 and a2): products combined with coefficients 20995/9633/16069/3196/7373/2446/16819/25172/12299, forming v53/v58/v69/v14-v25.
Store eight rounded stage-one results into the a3 output buffer at indices 0/8/16/24/32/40/48/56: (term + 1024) >> 11.
Stage-two loop: do-while 8 iterations (v51 countdown from 8); each iteration reads a dword index from the a4 offset table (v74 += 4) and forms the output pointer v27 = a5 + index.

Second butterfly pass over the stage-one a3 buffer (v49[0..7]): recomputes the same rotation structure with coefficients 6270/4433/15137/20995/9633/16069/3196/7373/2446/16819/25172/12299 to form v54/v59/v62/v64/v66/v68/v70-v73.
Window lookup: four rounds per output pack v42 and v43 by reading bytes from the a6 coefficient table at index ((x + 0x20000) >> 18) & 0x3FF, shifting each accumulated byte up by 8.
Write the two packed dwords to the output region: v27[0] = v42 and v27[1] = v43.
Return the stage-two loop countdown result (the final value of v51, which reaches 0).
Invoked by RenderingBranchOnDAT005d79dc (0x0052855A) to convert frequency-domain subband samples for the audio output path.
